prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: horizontal editorial cover photograph for a Spanish publication about AI and work
Primary request: an emergency medical technician in an ambulance bay calmly checks a portable medical kit before a night shift, representing the essential services affected by digital systems.
Scene/backdrop: real hospital ambulance entrance at night with softly blurred lights and equipment, no visible monitors or writing.
Style/medium: candid documentary photography, respectful and believable healthcare work, subtle 35mm film grain.
Composition/framing: cinematic 16:9 landscape, technician and open medical kit clearly visible, face focused.
Lighting/mood: cool outdoor ambient light balanced by a restrained red ambulance reflection, calm and alert.
Color palette: deep warm shadows, muted medical whites, natural skin, small red accent.
Constraints: no text, logo, watermark, no patient shown.
Avoid: office, paperwork, computer screens, robots, panic, blood, staged medical stock photo.
